title: Dungeon Quest v3.3.2.0 Evidence Ledger v15

entries.claim: Matching ARM64 native split is present in the uploaded v3.3.2.0 XAPK; signatures match across all 20 contained APKs.
DEX message 600 routes to IAPWrapper.l(String), 602 to IAPWrapper.m(String, boolean), and restore message 601 to IAPWrapper.n().
entries.next_test: instrument or runtime trace one SKU request

entries.claim: JNI purchase-success export sends an engine event to InAppPurchase.onPurchaseSuccess.
entries.evidence_type: ARM64 direct-call and native event strings
entries.impact: bridges billing wrapper to native game-model layer

entries.claim: InAppPurchase reads sAIHandler and dispatches the success notification through the engine; exact runtime destination is dynamic.
entries.evidence_type: native variable lookup and indirect dispatch
entries.confidence: high for dynamic dispatch; medium for destination
entries.next_test: decode AIM binding and observe sAIHandler value in game

entries.claim: gold1–gold5 branches call RewardGold with exact constants 20M, 50M, 150M, 350M, and 1B Gold.
entries.next_test: controlled in-game balance diff for each pack before replacing product UI

entries.claim: SKU gold refers to boostGold state, crystal to boostCS, and mythstone to boostMS; they are not proven direct currency grants.
entries.evidence_type: direct product/state string refs in success handler
entries.next_test: trace duration/stack values and active gameplay effect

entries.claim: package1–package21 and special bundles map to named vanity flags in native success handler; package20/21 are native/DEX SKU strings without IAP.xml rows.
entries.evidence_type: product branch strings and iap.vanity references
entries.impact: can replace bundle contents deterministically instead of random-only acquisition
entries.next_test: runtime per-product ownership state diff and reload

entries.claim: uai_gp_account::GetIAPString is called by onUpload and SetIAP is called by onDownloadResult; this is account upload/download serialization, not proven local save persistence.
entries.symbol_or_offset: GetIAPString@0x4edff8; callsite 0x535028 from onUpload@0x5346c0; SetIAP@0x4faa2c; callsite 0x50b0a8 from onDownloadResult@0x509670
entries.next_test: trace local account save/load path separately and compare a live field

entries.claim: Generic vanity handler plus account keys iap.vanity1–iap.vanity74 support SKU suffix to Vanity.xml row mapping, but live entitlement mutation has not been observed.
entries.evidence_type: native key correlation + asset row match
entries.impact: key mapping for 46 direct IAP vanity SKUs
entries.next_test: purchase/equip/reload state diff for representative vanity IDs

entries.claim: Data-only patch gives all 46 IAP-linked vanity SKU rows a Gold route, assigns proposed Gold to vanity72/73, and adds the missing Shop Tab3 listings.
entries.evidence_type: decoded STK diff and full output verification

entries.claim: Patched STK has 5,630 entries passing CRC32 and decoded-size validation; 5,628 decoded entries unchanged and the two changed entries are Vanity.xml and Shop.xml.
entries.source_file: v15_verify_economy.json; local STK source and output
entries.impact: ensures immutable source and minimal data diff
entries.next_test: re-run validator from clean branch using source pack supplied by user

entries.claim: The cosmetic data patch does not disable billing/purchase code and is not full IAP replacement.
entries.impact: sets honest scope of current deliverable
entries.next_test: patch billing entry points only after rebuildable APK tooling/path is established

entries.claim: debug.hud contains level/feat/CS/MS/Boss test labels; no direct Pause/Options-to-debug.hud open edge has been established yet.
entries.confidence: high for labels; low for reachability
entries.next_test: parse model registry + AIM event/parent references; confirm a real open/show call edge

entries.claim: A fully integrated Cheat/Sandbox page has not been added to native Pause → Options; there is no verified handler/state adapter or reversible state mutation.
entries.source_file: branch tree and pause/options AIM/HUD evidence
entries.next_test: establish one reversible diagnostics/state adapter and an Android-rebuildable patch path

entries.claim: Native libraries are now recovered, but the available environment has no apktool/aapt2/apksigner/zipalign and no device/emulator runtime.
entries.symbol_or_offset: libS3DClient.so is available locally; build tools absent
entries.impact: prevents verified installable mod APK in this run
entries.next_test: obtain supported Android build/repack toolchain and device/emulator

entries.claim: Feature branch is open draft and the branch history diverges from main; repo remains curated rather than containing all 68 app-specific disassemblies and 68 Java scaffolds.
entries.source_file: GitHub PR #26 and recursive Git tree
entries.symbol_or_offset: historical audit head 8bd0f536a6ec6cef3d0b2a47a173a5810fed28d3; tree 246 entries; 2 .smali; 0 reconstruction/java scaffolds
